title: Configuration
description:
All options live in the file randomthings-common.toml, in the sections worldgen, loot, features, visual and numbers. Options are read when they are used; loot options are read when loot tables load, so they need a world reload or restart.

- worldgen: turn generation of Lotus, Peace Candle churches, Ancient Furnaces and Glowing Mushrooms on or off.
- loot: turn chest loot additions on or off.
- features: turn some optional mod features on or off.
- visual: client look options.
- numbers: limits and chances.

Options are listed below as section.key, with the default and what each does.

properties.label: worldgen.Lotus
properties.value: default true - Lotus plants generate in Snowy biomes.

properties.label: worldgen.PeaceCandle
properties.value: default true - Village churches may contain a Peace Candle.

properties.label: worldgen.AncientFurnace
properties.value: default true - Ancient Furnaces generate in cold biomes.

properties.label: worldgen.GlowingMushrooms
properties.value: default true - Glowing Mushroom patches generate in caves.

properties.label: loot.MagicHood
properties.value: default true - Magic Hood can appear in dungeon and village weaponsmith chests.

properties.label: loot.SummoningPendulum
properties.value: default true - Summoning Pendulum can appear in dungeon and stronghold corridor chests.

properties.label: loot.BiomeCrystal
properties.value: default true - Chests can contain a Biome Crystal.

properties.label: loot.SlimeCube
properties.value: default true - Slime Cube can appear in dungeon and jungle temple chests.

properties.label: features.ArtificialEndPortal
properties.value: default true - An Evil Tear used on an End Rod can create an Artificial End Portal.

properties.label: features.MagneticEnchantment
properties.value: default true - The Magnetic enchantment can be obtained from enchanting tables and books and works.

properties.label: features.GoldenEgg
properties.value: default true - Bean Pods also drop a Golden Egg.

properties.label: features.EnderAnchorChunkloading
properties.value: default true - Ender Anchors keep their chunk loaded.

properties.label: visual.FlatRunes
properties.value: default false - Runes use a flat texture.

properties.label: visual.HideCoordinates
properties.value: default false - Hides the coordinates shown on Portkeys and Position Filters.

properties.label: numbers.BlockDestabilizerLimit
properties.value: default 50 - Maximum number of blocks a Block Destabilizer affects; 0 means unlimited.

properties.label: numbers.TriggerGlassChainLimit
properties.value: default 20 - Maximum number of touching Trigger Glass blocks triggered per pulse; 0 means unlimited.

properties.label: numbers.SpiritLifeTime
properties.value: default 400 - Ticks before a Spirit disappears (minimum 1).

properties.label: numbers.SpiritChanceNormal
properties.value: default 0.01 - Base chance (0 to 1) that an entity killed by a player spawns a Spirit.

properties.label: numbers.SpiritChanceMoonMult
properties.value: default 2.0 - Multiplier (0 to 1000) for the extra Spirit chance at night under open sky, scaled by the moon phase.

properties.label: numbers.SpiritChanceEndIncrease
properties.value: default 0.07 - Extra Spirit chance added once the Ender Dragon has been killed.
